# Copilot instructions

- This is a beginner HTML/CSS learning portfolio made mostly of standalone static pages; Bootstrap lessons load the framework from its CDN, and there is no project build system or package manager.
- Keep each lesson runnable by opening its `index.html` directly. Preserve the course folder structure and relative asset paths.
- Use semantic HTML, accessible link text, and descriptive alternative text for informative images.
- Keep the root portfolio responsive and usable on small screens; shared root-page styles belong in `style.css`.
- Do not add personal contact details, credentials, or external dependencies without the owner's direction.
- Treat `goal.png` files and solution files as course references; do not publish them as completed work.
